basic_details.job_title: Civil Court Chaibasa Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 17 Peon & Driver Posts
basic_details.short_information: Civil Court, West Singhbhum, Chaibasa (Civil Court Chaibasa) has notified 17 vacancies for Peon / Orderly / Driver posts, comprising 15 vacancies for Peon / Orderly and 2 vacancies for Driver. Eligible candidates must submit their offline applications by hand, registered post, or speed post to Prabhari Nyayadhish, Vyavahar Nyayalay, Pashchim Singhbhum, Chaibasa, Pin Code on or before 31 October 2026. Qualifications are 10th pass or equivalent for Peon / Orderly and Matriculation with LMV driving license for Driver, with a pay of 18000-56900 (Level-1) and 19900-63200 (Level-2) respectively. The

content_sections.heading: Civil Court Chaibasa Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: 10th Pass / Matriculation with LMV Driving License

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must send their self-written application and admit card in Devanagari script addressed to the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Civil Court, West Singhbhum, Chaibasa, either by hand or through registered/speed post on any working day between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM by 31 October 2026. Postal Address: Prabhari Nyayadhish, Vyavahar Nyayalay, Pashchim Singhbhum, Chaibasa, Pin Code - 833201

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Peon / Orderly: Matriculation (10th) pass or equivalent from a recognized board. Driver: Matriculation or equivalent with a valid Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) driving license and driving experience as specified in motor vehicle rules. Age Limit (as on 01-10-2026): Minimum age is 18 years. Maximum age limits are 35 years for Unreserved and EWS male candidates, 38 years for women candidates, and 40 years for Scheduled Tribe (Male/Female) candidates. Age relaxations apply according to Jharkhand State rules. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational certificates, mark sheets, and required qualifications. Caste and reservation certificates issued by competent authorities, if applicable. Three recent passport-size photographs (one affixed to the application, one to the admit card, and one extra). Self-addressed stamped envelope (25 cm x 11 cm) with Rs. 56 postage stamps. No Objection Certificate (NOC) if currently working in any government institution or corporation.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a Screening Test and an Interview for Peon / Orderly posts, and a Driving Test based on driving rules along with a Screening Test and Interview for Driver posts.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for Civil Court Chaibasa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 31 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Peon / Orderly post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation (10th) or an equivalent examination from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age relaxation in this recruitment?
faq.answer: Upper age limits are relaxed up to 38 years for women candidates and up to 40 years for Scheduled Tribe (male/female) candidates, alongside provisions for EWS and other categories as per Jharkhand State rules.

faq.question: Q4. What documents and enclosures must be sent with the offline application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of educational and category certificates, three passport-size photographs, and a self-addressed stamped envelope (25 cm x 11 cm) bearing Rs. 56 postage.
